_source: Figma 'Moon Phases · Closing slide' (135:888), sections '0N <phase> · all 40 variations'. Each frame's body = pattern[phase][pattern] + ' ' + reversal[phase][reversedCount].

new-moon.OEC: Something new wants to move, something wants to stay steady, and someone is part of it. Set an intention that makes room for all three.
new-moon.OOE: Most of your cards want to move. The new start is ready, and one steady thing will keep it grounded.
new-moon.EEO: Most of your cards want stability. Start small, with one gentle push forward.
new-moon.OOC: Action is calling, and a person is at the center of it. Begin with them in mind.
new-moon.EEC: Things are calm, and someone is shaping what comes next. Plant the seed together.
new-moon.OOO: Every card is in motion. This fresh start wants to happen fast. Let it.
new-moon.EEE: Every card is still. Your new beginning is a quiet one. No rush.
new-moon.CCO: This start is mostly about people, and one of them is ready to make a move.
new-moon.CCE: This start is about the people around you, and it begins with steadiness.
new-moon.CCC: All three cards are people. Tonight's new beginning is a relationship, maybe with yourself.

waxing-crescent.OEC: Growth is coming from motion, patience, and a person who cares. Keep all three close.
waxing-crescent.OOE: Things are picking up speed. Keep one routine steady while it grows.
waxing-crescent.EEO: Growth is slow and steady, with one bright spark. Feed the spark.
waxing-crescent.OOC: Someone is helping this grow fast. Let them.
waxing-crescent.EEC: Someone is helping this grow gently. Lean on them.
waxing-crescent.OOO: It's all momentum. Keep showing up and it'll take off.
waxing-crescent.EEE: It's all patience. Tiny steps are enough right now.
waxing-crescent.CCO: People are what's growing here, and one connection is gaining speed.
waxing-crescent.CCE: Your relationships are growing quietly and steadily.
waxing-crescent.CCC: Every card is a person. What's growing tonight is your circle.

first-quarter.OEC: You're weighing change against comfort, and someone's opinion matters. Decide what's yours to choose.
first-quarter.OOE: Most of you wants to act. Make the call, then hold one thing steady.
first-quarter.EEO: Most of you wants to stay put, but one part is pushing. Listen to it.
first-quarter.OOC: Someone is pushing you to decide. Make sure the choice is yours.
first-quarter.EEC: Someone wants you to stay steady. Ask if that's what you want too.
first-quarter.OOO: Everything is urging you forward. Decide and go.
first-quarter.EEE: Everything says hold. The decision might be to wait.
first-quarter.CCO: This choice is about people, and one of them is ready to move.
first-quarter.CCE: This choice is about people and keeping the peace. Be honest anyway.
first-quarter.CCC: All people, no plan. The decision is really about who you trust.

waxing-gibbous.OEC: You're close, with motion, steadiness, and a helper on your side. Fine-tune, don't overhaul.
waxing-gibbous.OOE: You're moving fast toward the finish. Slow down just enough to get it right.
waxing-gibbous.EEO: You're nearly done and steady. One last push will finish it.
waxing-gibbous.OOC: Someone is helping you finish strong. Take their notes.
waxing-gibbous.EEC: Someone is helping you finish carefully. Trust the pace.
waxing-gibbous.OOO: Everything is racing toward the end. Don't skip the details.
waxing-gibbous.EEE: Everything is settled. Polish what you have.
waxing-gibbous.CCO: The people around you are almost aligned. One more conversation.
waxing-gibbous.CCE: Your relationships are close to steady. Keep tending them.
waxing-gibbous.CCC: It's all about people now. Check in before you finish.

full-moon.OEC: Tonight shows you what's moving, what's holding, and who's involved. See all of it clearly.
full-moon.OOE: Big energy is lit up tonight. Let it move, but keep your footing.
full-moon.EEO: What's steady is in full view, with one thing stirring. Notice it.
full-moon.OOC: Someone's actions are in the spotlight tonight. Watch before you react.
full-moon.EEC: Someone's steady presence is lit up tonight. Appreciate it.
full-moon.OOO: Everything is moving at once under a full moon. Ride it, carefully.
full-moon.EEE: Everything is still and clear tonight. Look closely.
full-moon.CCO: People are center stage tonight, and one of them is making waves.
full-moon.CCE: Tonight lights up the people who keep you steady.
full-moon.CCC: All three cards are people under a full moon. Feelings about them run high.

waning-gibbous.OEC: You've learned something about change, patience, and people. Share it.
waning-gibbous.OOE: The momentum taught you something. Pass it on.
waning-gibbous.EEO: The steadiness taught you something. Thank whoever helped.
waning-gibbous.OOC: Someone showed you how to move. Tell them.
waning-gibbous.EEC: Someone showed you how to stay steady. Tell them.
waning-gibbous.OOO: All that motion has a lesson in it. Write it down.
waning-gibbous.EEE: All that stillness has a lesson in it. Share it gently.
waning-gibbous.CCO: The people in your life taught you to move. Give a little back.
waning-gibbous.CCE: The people in your life taught you patience. Thank them.
waning-gibbous.CCC: Every card is a person. Tonight is for gratitude toward your people.

last-quarter.OEC: Let go of what's rushing you, what's holding you back, or who's weighing on you. Pick one.
last-quarter.OOE: Release some of the pressure to keep moving.
last-quarter.EEO: Release one thing that's keeping you stuck.
last-quarter.OOC: Let go of someone else's urgency. It isn't yours.
last-quarter.EEC: Let go of someone's expectations of you.
last-quarter.OOO: Too much motion. Drop something before it drops you.
last-quarter.EEE: Too much holding still. Release what's gone stale.
last-quarter.CCO: Let go of a dynamic that keeps pulling you around.
last-quarter.CCE: Let go of a relationship habit that keeps you small.
last-quarter.CCC: All three cards are people. Release what you've been carrying for them.

waning-crescent.OEC: Rest from the motion, from the effort of staying steady, and from other people's needs.
waning-crescent.OOE: You've been moving a lot. Let yourself stop.
waning-crescent.EEO: You've been holding steady. Rest, then take one small step.
waning-crescent.OOC: Someone has kept you busy. Take a night away from it.
waning-crescent.EEC: Someone has been your anchor. Let them hold you tonight.
waning-crescent.OOO: Everything's been in motion. Rest is the bravest move now.
waning-crescent.EEE: Everything is still. Let it be. Sleep.
waning-crescent.CCO: People have kept you going. Take a night for yourself.
waning-crescent.CCE: Your people are steady. You can rest knowing that.
waning-crescent.CCC: All three cards are people. Rest from everyone, including yourself.

new-moon: Every card is upright, so the beginning is out in the open and ready to act on.
One card is reversed, so part of this fresh start is still waiting inside you.
Two cards are reversed, so most of this beginning is happening internally first.
All three are reversed, so the new start begins in private, long before anyone sees it.
waxing-crescent: Every card is upright, so the growth is visible if you look for it.
One card is reversed, so a little doubt is slowing the sprout. That's okay.
Two cards are reversed, so the roots are growing before the leaves.
All three are reversed, so the growth is underground for now. Trust it.
first-quarter: Every card is upright, so the choice is clear, even if it's hard.
One card is reversed, so part of you is still resisting the decision.
Two cards are reversed, so the real tension is inside you, not out there.
All three are reversed, so you're wrestling with yourself more than the situation.
waxing-gibbous: Every card is upright, so the finish line is in plain sight.
One card is reversed, so one thing still needs adjusting.
Two cards are reversed, so the refining is mostly inner work.
All three are reversed, so you're polishing something only you can see yet.
full-moon: Everything's upright, so it's out in the open, nothing hidden.
One card is reversed, so part of what's lit up is still happening quietly inside you.
Two cards are reversed, so the brightest light is on what you feel, not what you see.
All three are reversed, so tonight's full moon is shining inward.
waning-gibbous: Every card is upright, so the lesson is clear and easy to name.
One card is reversed, so part of the lesson is still sinking in.
Two cards are reversed, so the lesson is mostly about you.
All three are reversed, so the wisdom here is private for now.
last-quarter: Every card is upright, so you can see clearly what to release.
One card is reversed, so one part is still hard to let go of.
Two cards are reversed, so the letting go is mostly emotional.
All three are reversed, so you're releasing something no one else can see.
waning-crescent: Every card is upright, so the rest is simple. Just take it.
One card is reversed, so part of you is still restless.
Two cards are reversed, so rest your mind as well as your body.
All three are reversed, so the quiet you need is deep and inward.
